chunks: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:
Supplications are the keys to success and the treasuries of prosperity.
The best supplication is that which emanates from a pure chest and a pious heart.
In intimate prayer lies the cause of salvation, and through sincerity comes liberation.
When fear intensifies, then to God is the refuge.

key_terms.الْإِخْلَاص: Sincerity/ikhlas — pure devotion to God without any admixture of worldly motive
key_terms.الْمُنَاجَاة: Intimate supplication — private, whispered prayer expressing the deepest yearning of the soul
key_terms.صَدْرٌ نَقِيٌّ: Pure chest — a heart free from hypocrisy, ill intent, and spiritual disease
key_terms.قَلْبٌ تَقِيٌّ: Pious heart — a heart filled with God-consciousness (taqwa)
key_terms.مَفَاتِيحُ النَّجَاحِ: Keys to success — supplication as the means to unlock divine assistance
key_terms.مَقَالِيدُ الْفَلَاحِ: Treasuries/collars of prosperity — supplication grants access to spiritual flourishing

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about supplication being the key to success?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) extols the power and virtue of supplication in this profound teaching. He identifies du'a as the fundamental instrument of success and salvation, emphasizing that its efficacy depends on purity of the inner self — both the chest (seat of intentions) and the heart. The saying culminates in the declaration that when existential fear strikes, God alone is the refuge, reflecting the Shia theological emphasis on exclusive reliance upon the Divine.

en.hubeali: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The supplications are the keys to achievement and collars of the success, and the best of the supplication is what is generated by a clean chest and a fearful heart’.
en.sarwar: 2. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Pleading before Allah for help is the key to success and the input for one’s well being.
The best prayer is what comes out of a clean chest and pious heart.
In pleading before Allah for help there is the means for salvation, in sincerity there is freedom
and when distress intensifies, Allah is the only One before Whom one must implore for protection.”
